help.title: Help center
help.subtitle: Answers, shortcuts, and ways to reach us.

publishArticle.question: How do I publish an article?
publishArticle.answer: Open the article in the block editor under Articles, move its status to Approved, then use Publish. Scheduled articles publish automatically at their set time.

manageRoles.question: How do I change a user's role or permissions?
manageRoles.answer: Go to Management → Roles & Permissions to edit role definitions, or open a user under Users to assign a role directly.

featureWriter.question: How do I feature a writer on the homepage or magazine?
featureWriter.answer: In Writers, use the Main and Magazine toggles on a writer's row — Main features them on the homepage, Magazine adds them to the editorial board.

moderateContent.question: Where do user-submitted contributions get reviewed?
moderateContent.answer: Contributions live under Content → Content Library, separate from Articles. Review status and moderate them there before they become published articles.

resetPassword.question: How do I reset a user's password?
resetPassword.answer: Open the user under Users and use the account actions menu to send a password reset, or create a temporary password when linking a new writer account.

webhookIssues.question: A Stripe payment isn't reflecting in the app — what do I check?
webhookIssues.answer: Check Finance & Payout for the transaction, then confirm the Stripe webhook endpoint is reachable and the event was received in your Stripe dashboard.

help.footerNote: Support responses typically arrive within one business day.
